validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE: real, not a hallucination. Mubarek-Zirabulak (БГР-ТБА, part of the wider Bukhara-Tashkent-Bishkek-Almaty trunk) is a genuine Soviet-era system with THREE parallel physical threads (нитки I, II, III), independently confirmed by uzreport.news 2020-09-09 ('EPSILON (EDC): Продолжается развитие газотранспортной инфраструктуры Узбекистана'), which describes capital overhaul of 'Мубарек-Зирабулак (БГР-ТБА) I, II, III нитки, участок 50-78 км (Ø1020х12 мм - 2,1 км)' by Зирабулакское УМГ (Zirabulak pipeline-management unit), plus a separate contract on threads I-II, section 3-50 km (Ø1020x12 mm, 8.0 km). Uztransgaz's own 2020 Business Plan (official document, utg.uz/upload/medialibrary/378/3782e1330a84effbfd65bf5ba92cb363.pdf, verified live via url_verifier and manually read with pdftotext since the automated substring screen misses large PDFs -- see url_verifier.py's own documented caveat) lists 'Мубарекское управление магистральными газопроводами' and 'Зирабулакское управление магистральными газопроводами' as two of Uztransgaz's eight direct trunk-transport subdivisions, located in Kashkadarya oblast (Mubarek) and Samarkand oblast/Naprai district, Aktash (Zirabulak) respectively -- confirming this is a real, actively-maintained trunk corridor, not a GEM-only entity.

DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate of P6933/P6934. The overhaul contract explicitly names three separate threads (I, II, III) undergoing repair as distinct physical pipes on the same corridor -- exactly the Kazakhstan cluster-A lesson (a parallel-string pattern is real pipe unless a source affirmatively says otherwise; here the source affirmatively describes three separate threads). No source anywhere describes I/II/III as one pipe or a double count.

CLASSIFICATION: correct. This is a trunk transmission line, not a gathering/feeder line -- Zirabulakskoe and Mubarekskoe UMG are both classified 'Транспорт природного газа' (natural gas TRANSPORT) in Uztransgaz's own structural table, and the corridor carries compressor-station-supported interstate/export gas (Uzbekistan -> Kyrgyzstan -> Kazakhstan), consistent with PipelineType=transmission.

ATTRIBUTION (Location, Fuel): Location (Mubarek -> Zirabulak, both Uzbekistan) is directly confirmed -- both are named, geographically distinct Uztransgaz management-unit seats in the Business Plan's location table (Kashkadarya obl., g. Mubarek / Samarkand obl., Narpay r-n, g. Aktash). Fuel=Gas is trivially correct (природный газ throughout every source).

SPEC (diameter -- see recommendation): the sheet's cited Diameter ref does not actually support the sheet's Diameter value. This is the row's real defect.

STATUS: see status_reviews below -- confirmed operating.

Existing refs checked for access, not deleted: Status/Location ref (kun.uz 2020-12-26) is live (200, verified); its 'operating' status-token miss in the worklist's automated check is expected per url_verifier's own documented rule (status is inferable from repair-in-progress context, not required as a literal English substring on a Russian page) -- kept as-is. Fuel/PipelineType ref (Facebook video, epsilonuzbekistan) is live (200, verified) -- kept, content not independently re-verifiable since it is a video, but it is the contractor's own project documentation and plausible on its face; no reason found to doubt it.
